```yaml
name: End-to-End Tests on Windows

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  e2e-windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          go mod download
          go get github.com/goreleaser/goreleaser@latest
          go get github.com/mise/mise@latest

      - name: Run fmt and lint checks
        run: mise run fmt && mise run lint

      - name: Run unit and integration tests
        run: mise run test:ci

      - name: Skip interactive E2E tests on Windows
        run: echo "Skipping interactive E2E tests on Windows"

      - name: Notify Slack on failure
        if: ${{ failure() }}
        run: |
          curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' --data "{\"text\": \"E2E tests failed on Windows\"}" https://hooks.slack.com/services/T00000000/B00000000/XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX
```
